classifications.rationale: The President is reporting to Congress that he previously issued an executive order declaring an emergency and establishing property-blocking and designation authorities; this segment does not itself impose those legal consequences, which arose under the earlier order.
classifications.evidence: I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order

classifications.rationale: The President is reporting a prior delegation to the Treasury Secretary, implementation direction to agencies, and the earlier order’s effective time; the segment itself neither makes a new delegation nor changes legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The order, a copy of which is enclosed, became effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on October 30, 2006.
